reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR code, and anyone can print that. There are zero reviews, so I have nothing to check for stomach problems, pill size or whether the dose is real, and I don't buy without hundreds of reviews.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR to the brand's own chosen lab is still the brand grading itself, and I can't read 1-star reviews to see what goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred reviews with the 1-star ones showing no stomach or dosing complaints.
